review.appReviewNotes:
Paste this text into App Store Connect > App Review Information > Notes.

DISTRIBUTION AND AUDIENCE
AliStore Courier is a limited employee resource for AliStore couriers and is intended for Unlisted App distribution. It shows deliveries assigned by AliStore, supports route and handover status, delivery evidence and cash-on-delivery reconciliation. It is not offered as a public multi-tenant subscription service and has no public self-service registration.

DEMO ACCOUNT
Use the username and matching credential entered in the Demo Account fields. Enter them exactly in the two Russian-labelled fields on the sign-in screen, then tap the sign-in button. The review path has no SMS or one-time-code step. The account must be active and two-factor authentication must be disabled before resubmission. No credential is included in these notes or in repository metadata.

REVIEW DATA
The owner must verify successful sign-in and an assigned review delivery immediately before resubmission. These notes do not claim that a route, delivery or cash-on-delivery record has been seeded until that gate passes.

WHAT TO EXPECT
Access is role-based and authorized by the AliStore server. The app hands an assigned delivery address to the system Maps app for navigation and does not request device location access. The app does not track users across apps or websites and its privacy manifest declares NSPrivacyTracking=false.

UNLISTED REQUEST
An Unlisted App distribution request must be submitted for this app. Please evaluate this submission for that limited employee audience rather than for public App Store discovery.

CONTACT
Support: https://ali.kg/support.

ru-KG.description: AliStore Courier — приложение доставки для розничных магазинов электроники. Курьер магазина видит назначенные доставки и маршрут, фиксирует результат вручения заказа, ведёт операции с наложенными платежами и сверяет завершённый рейс. Доступ ролевой: магазин выдаёт учётные записи своим курьерам.
